formulaIdentity.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of packet canonicalInci joined with ', '
formulaIdentity.sourceTier: frozen packet canonical INCI; positioning: manufacturer only
formulaIdentity.conflictNotes: 'blaue Malve' maps to Malva Sylvestris Flower Extract (16); 'Zink PCA' to Zinc PCA (11). The claim attributes anti-dandruff action to Zinc PCA, which is not a recognized active (Section 11); the recognized active Piroctone Olamine (6) is present but unnamed in claims. Not a conflict.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (4); no reinforcing anionic. Weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate (7) noted; no realistic neighbor.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9) and weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate (7), humectants Panthenol (12), Glycerin (14). No silicone, lipid or pearlizer. Counter-signal toward moderate: guar plus refatter.

excluded: Zinc PCA (11): scalp active, not deposition

depositionLoad.rationale: One guar plus one weak refatter.

persistence.rationale: No silicone, lipid or film; weak refatter weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES with betaine and glucoside.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families present (guar + weak refatter).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light routes only against moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2 specific evidence): besides a single guar the only other family is weak_refatter Glyceryl Oleate plus humectants; no silicone, payload lipid, protein or film former; SLES/betaine/glucoside reset faces only light routes.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims credit Zinc PCA/Malve rather than the recognized active; SLES chassis.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: 'Anti Schuppen' in the product name (high) plus recognized active Piroctone Olamine (6) -> 7.2 problem-led dandruff row -> scalp_active. No lengths-care claim (F7 not needed).

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; the itch/tension role is part of scalp_active, no lengths-care positioning.

usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular considered; dandruffSupport supported and qualifying E2 dandruff claim graded high -> treatment (U3, U1).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: SC1: the manufacturer sentence 'Deine juckende Kopfhaut wird beruhigt und das Spannungsgefühl reduziert.' is its own claim unit (one sentence, E2a) that does not name 'Schuppen', so it is explicit sensitive (juckende Kopfhaut, beruhigt) and dry (Spannungsgefühl) positioning, graded moderate. Supportive architecture: buffered C1 chassis with glucoside and betaine, comfort route Panthenol (12), humectants Glycerin (14), refatter Glyceryl Oleate (7), no menthol/essential oils. Counter-signals: Parfum, SLES; the sentence follows a dandruff sentence, so the itch may be dandruff-related. Moderate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine (6). Zinc PCA is not a recognized active.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. Scalp-concern targets; no not_suited, so T6 lifts nothing. T4: fine ideal -> W neighbor moderate gives acceptable -> flag fine; normal stays ideal; coarse stays acceptable.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: name 'Anti Schuppen' (high) + dandruffSupport supported (high) -> pass, primary by S-PRIMARY (named in product name). S-SENSITIVE: own non-dandruff unit (moderate), targeted, prominent E4 comfort route Panthenol (12), cleansing moderate -> pass. S-DRY: same sentence's 'Spannungsgefühl' unit (moderate), targeted, prominent humectant Glycerin (14)/Panthenol (12)/Glyceryl Oleate (7) -> pass. Three qualifying targets: keep dandruff + highest-precedence secondary sensitive; drop dry and raise review_extra_scalp_target (S-SECONDARY). Dandruff-symptom units ('Bei Schuppen und juckender Kopfhaut', 'von Schuppen und einer juckenden, spannenden Kopfhaut') were absorbed (E2a) and did not create targets.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular: matches schuppen (regular), differs from irritationen (gentle, amber, I2). I3: neighbor none -> no flag.
reviewFlags: review_extra_scalp_target: dry not projected (third qualifying target)

uncertainties: E2a sentence granularity: 'Deine juckende Kopfhaut wird beruhigt und das Spannungsgefühl reduziert.' directly continues a dandruff sentence. Read literally it is an independent non-dandruff unit and creates sensitive + dry targets; read contextually it is a dandruff symptom and the product would be dandruff-only (and scalpComfortTarget not_targeted). This is the decisive call for the secondary target.
